ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a periodic rectangular wave, the vertical axis is marked with +1 and -1, and the horizontal axis is marked with 0, T/2, T, t. The waveform is at a positive level of about +1 between 0 and T/2, is at a negative level of about -1 between T/2 and T, and repeats with period T. Reasoning: This waveform is a square wave with a 50% duty cycle, satisfying half-wave symmetry f(t+T/2) = -f(t). In the Fourier series of a periodic waveform with half-wave symmetry, even harmonics are zero. Therefore, the amplitude of the second harmonic component is 0.
